_note: Where the units web sites live. The docs are a site and a repository of their own (https://github.com/plsdontcallmyfone/units-docs: content, build, tests, deploy) whose canonical origin is always docs_canonical. app_url: the app's own origin, the mainnet site until the owner's app domain exists, then that domain; the docs repository keeps its copy of it in its site.json (the app the docs link to and read live figures from), change both together. docs_url: where the app's /docs redirects and in-app docs links go; the temporary docs host until the DNS record of docs.units.gg exists, then https://docs.units.gg. The environment overrides docs_url for one build or one server: UNITS_DOCS_URL (app server, app bundles, deploy kit). metadata_origin: the origin written into the on-chain metadata URI of every coin launched on mainnet (<metadata_origin>/coin/<mint>.json, served by the app server, apps/web/coin-metadata.ts); the owner's permanent app domain, https://app.units.gg (owner 2026-10-12). It is on chain for good in every coin launched with it, so it is set once and never follows app_url; UNITS_METADATA_ORIGIN overrides it for one server (the devnet site uses its own host). mainnet_site_url and devnet_site_url: the deployed backend of each network (Core, indexer, the /chain proxy). The static build (scripts/deploy/vercel/build.ts) and a local dashboard with no backend of its own (apps/web/server.ts) use the one of the default network, mainnet; UNITS_SITE overrides it.
